suspected_cause: Physical Information Gap (No Atmospheric Thermodynamics or Convective Sounding Data)
evidence_found: Convective storms in Meghalaya have 30-90 min lifecycles. At +180m and +360m predicted heavy rain intensity drops to 4.9% of true value; temporal variance collapses by 98.6% (1.819 to 0.025). The model cannot predict new convective initiation from 2D cloud tops alone.
recommended_corrective_action: Incorporate low-level moisture convergence (850 hPa RH/winds) and convective instability (CAPE/CIN) from ERA5 or GFS reanalysis/NWP.

suspected_cause: Objective Function Blurring (L2/Smooth-L1 Conditional Expectation Collapse)
evidence_found: Under high spatial uncertainty at long horizons L2/Smooth L1 loss drives predictions to conditional mean E[Y|X]. Spatial gradient ratio drops from 0.736 to 0.098 (severe blur) and predictions collapse to static regional climatology (r=0.806). Focal loss broke probability calibration (ECE degraded 26x).
expected_impact: HIGH (Preserves storm intensity boundaries and gradients)
recommended_corrective_action: Implement scale-dependent spatial loss (Multiscale SSIM / Fractions Skill Score loss) or generative/probabilistic quantile loss to penalize excessive smoothing.

suspected_cause: Extreme Class Imbalance & Fixed Thresholding Artifact (tau=0.50)
evidence_found: Heavy rain (>=5 mm/hr) constitutes only 3.54% of pixels (65.1% dry). At +360m uncalibrated ConvLSTM probabilities peak at 0.2840 (SimVP at 0.5665) causing TP=0 and CSI=0.0000 at fixed 0.50 threshold. Val-tuned threshold (tau=0.06) recovers CSI=0.0706 and ROC-AUC=0.7225 but reveals double-penalty FAR (>90%).
expected_impact: IMMEDIATE (Restores operational alarms without false-alarm explosion)
recommended_corrective_action: Calibrate decision thresholds strictly per horizon on validation data and evaluate with neighborhood/spatial verification metrics (FSS at 20-50 km).

suspected_cause: Limited Episode Diversity (Only 38 Training Days Across 4 Blocks)
evidence_found: Training dataset covers only 38 dates from four short 7-to-14 day windows in July and August. Seasonal onset (June) and withdrawal (September) and multi-year active/break monsoon variability are completely absent.
expected_impact: HIGH (Reduces overfitting to localized July synoptic regimes)
recommended_corrective_action: Expand dataset to 4-year full monsoon archive (June-September 2021-2024; 488 days; 21500 sequences; ~146 MB NetCDF4 via NASA CMR/OPeNDAP).

suspected_cause: Recurrent Sequential Bottleneck in ConvLSTM Architecture
evidence_found: ConvLSTM decodes all 5 future forecast horizons from a single shared recurrent hidden state h_T causing signal dissipation. SimVP non-recurrent translation boosted +120m CSI by +46.6% and +180m CSI by 17.2x but cannot overcome the physical convective ceiling at +360m alone.
expected_impact: MODERATE_TO_HIGH (Solves recurrent degradation at intermediate leads)
recommended_corrective_action: Adopt SimVP as the spatiotemporal backbone and focus research on thermodynamic features rather than testing more pure-CNN architectures.
